name: Migrate issue locations to anchors
description:
Issue locations become anchors. Still read legacy path:line:col and upgrade on write.
issues validate reports moved/changed/broken instead of LocationLineOutOfRange; validate --fix rewrites hints for moved anchors.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged b5c76a3. Locations are stored as flat anchor fields { path, line, span, symbol?, context, body, column? }; legacy { path, line?, column? } still loads and is upgraded on any save when the file and line exist (no invented hashes, updated not bumped). -l accepts path:line-end. validate reports LocationMoved/LocationChanged/LocationBroken (warnings) via one resolver batch; --fix rewrites only confident moves under the lock, doesn't bump updated, and emits fixed items with fixed:true in JSON. Core gained SymbolIndex.Supports(path). After merging, WriteProblems uses the shared ProblemTable. Note: the globally installed 'issues' tool is still the old version until it is repacked.
